scope: Independent original-image visual QA only; no parent verdict consulted, no art changes, approval, deployment or funds actions.
decision_policy: Existing user holds preserved. Neither verdict authorizes promotion or publication.

observations: Pastel geological bands, multi-peak relief, brass clasp/round disc/side ring and stone feet remain recognizable in model and illustration; the model uses more jagged, faceted strata.
All four viewer frames contain the full visible object and controls; open poses expose a hollow cavity.
concrete_defects: Fine ridge bands and hardware edges appear jagged, especially on mobile.
Body-to-trim stripe joins are abrupt; dark seam and coarse stone feet reduce construction clarity.
limitations: Pastel coloration, applied relief, broad body bands versus finer terrain bands and prominent seam are disclosed stylization, not newly established defects.
Unchanged lightweight model reviewed against promotional illustration for visual relationship, not equivalence. Rendering polish differences are not automatically model defects.

observations: Closed model and illustration show brass outlined rosette, bead border, warm body and cool seam; all four model frames are contained.
Open view shows the lid underside, so absence of exterior rosette there is not a defect.
concrete_defects: Broad cloudy brown-orange body finish reads ambiguously as wood/coating rather than convincingly hammered copper; promotional illustration especially strengthens the wood-like reading.
Thin rosette loops and perimeter beads lose definition at mobile scale; promotional petal spacing and center junctions look uneven/crowded.
Teal seam has stepped corner interruptions; open rim joins and hinge attachment silhouettes are hard to resolve.
limitations: Source explicitly discloses matte copper-colored coating and schematic wire-outline petals, plus intentional patina strip. Material-read ambiguity is a user aesthetic decision, not a confirmed regression or broken mesh.

All four model frames fit without cropping; open poses show cavity and underside, not the exterior ornament.
concrete_defects: Mobile crater depth is difficult to read; dark lower edges/feet blend into background and fine brass hardware is crowded.
Cyan trim has abrupt stepped interruptions at gray corner blocks; open rim joins look chunky.
Broad wavy stone texture reads soft rather than granular; illustration shows a dark boundary around the ornament insert and crowded flower/stone contacts.
